speaker: Jonas - Host
text: Hi everyone, welcome. Let's do a quick round of updates before we jump into the sprint review.

speaker: Aiko - PM
text: Thanks Jonas. From my side, the main blocker is still the data-sharing agreement with the Berlin office. Legal hasn't signed off yet.

speaker: Liam - Engineer
text: Right, we're blocked on that. We can't push the customer records module until we get sign-off on the cross-border data transfer.

speaker: Priya - QA
text: So does that mean we hold off on writing test cases for that module too?

speaker: Aiko - PM
text: I think so, yes. There's no point testing something that might change shape once legal responds.

speaker: Liam - Engineer
text: It's been two weeks now. Every time I ask, I get told it's pending approval.

speaker: Jonas - Host
text: Can we escalate this? Waiting for approval indefinitely isn't sustainable for the sprint.

speaker: Aiko - PM
text: I'll email the legal team again today and copy the director. Honestly I'm not sure when we'll get a decision.

speaker: Liam - Engineer
text: Because of this, the whole integration timeline with the Berlin team is basically stalled. We can't make progress either way.

speaker: Priya - QA
text: Should we work on something else in the meantime to not waste the sprint?

speaker: Aiko - PM
text: Yes, please pick up the reporting dashboard tickets instead. Let's revisit this blocker tomorrow.
